transformations: Licensed public tool calls/results are selected and reordered into synthetic sessions; they are not a chronological replay of the source trajectory.
All human lines, completion reports, interruption markers, lifecycle metadata and missing tool beats are authored. Each authored event is marked origin=authored and has no row reference.
S05 repeats one authored ModuleNotFoundError transaction three times; this recurrence is synthetic, not observed source recurrence.
Read/Edit/Write/Bash adapt OpenHands view/str_replace/create/execute_bash without counting views as edits.
Codex function_call exec arguments are JSON strings. Real old/new strings are mechanically formatted as apply_patch heredocs.
Sourced tools replace only the selected public workspace root with /home/sample/<repo>; real source paths and hunk text are unchanged. Authored path bindings are documented separately.
Outputs use contiguous source spans of at most 512 chars, or 2000 for failure/edit context. Write input content over 2000 chars is prefix-trimmed and disclosed per tool.
Human text is exactly script text after placeholder binding; the whole tests/<file>.py template is bound to the actual source test file, even when it is outside tests/.
P1 remains the literal authored label in the S10 human receipt; manifest P1 maps to Pylons/pyramid.
Required full-suite calls, install recovery, changelog, parsing-helper loop, diff review and normalized pytest runs absent from the locked rows are authored under the updated permission.
Authored pytest outputs are short illustrative summaries; missing-dependency traceback is generic. They were not run in source repos. No token usage is invented.
Interrupted tools emit a call only, immediately followed by the agent-specific marker, then the scripted human directive. No success result is emitted for an interrupted call.
The <=12-events bound is on logical script beats, not transport JSONL lines; tool call/result and Codex metadata require separate records.

shape_validation.real_log_privacy: Previous shape census read only one small file per agent and retained names/types/counts. This finishing leg read no owner logs and ran no codex command.
notes: Spike arrived while conversion was running; it was read in full and checked before final delivery.

All emitted top-level/nested type values are supported by the spike source snapshot; optional call IDs and array outputs are supported by real logs but this fixture uses present IDs and string outputs.
Current RolloutItemWire uses snake_case type/payload envelopes. Probe item_completed was observed in the one rollout; no disagreement on that field.
Owner exec calls in the one inspected rollout used custom_tool_call; script-requested function_call exec is also supported by the public ResponseItem enum.
Claude Bash toolUseResult was observed as a string, so emitted Bash results use that shape.
Authored Codex context uses the supported workspace-write sandbox variant because these sessions apply patches; this is synthetic metadata, not a change to the owner environment.

No probe/spike disagreement required a change; public function_call exec remains the specified supported shape. No downstream parser was provided or executed. Verification checks fixture evidence, not card/room outcomes.
